metadata.title: Gramophone Nights
metadata.composer: Original, written in the style of electro-swing

provenance.source: Composed for this request. Not a transcription: it takes the idiom — a walking bass under a swung horn riff, blue notes, a minor vamp — and none of its tunes.

arrangements.label: Lead and walking bass, no sixths

dev.alegauss.piano.feel.swing: Swung eighths are written into the ticks as 320 + 160, a 2:1 triplet feel. The walking bass stays in straight quarters. Play it straight and it is still correct.
